Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids
Predict fire behaviour from fuels, weather and topography for operations and planning
Lead field crews and transfer field judgment to novices
Communicate during field emergencies and report incidents
Provide first aid and emergency medical care in remote field settings
Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings
Conduct prescribed fire from burn planning through ignition, holding and evaluation
Assess tree risk and structural condition
Drive and operate field vehicles safely on unpaved roads and off road
Maintain and repair field equipment and vehicles
Evaluate and certify others' task performance against position standards
Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty
Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work

topTasks.statement: Execute a firing operation that removes fuel between the control line and the fire under the firing boss's direction
Size up a new fire's fuels, weather, topography and values at risk to recommend initial attack tactics
Direct a crew's tactical assignment, adjusting tactics when observed fire behaviour or weather departs from the briefing
Brief incident personnel on expected fire behaviour and weather trends, highlighting watch-out situations for each division
Compare modelled fire behaviour with observed behaviour during an incident, adjusting predictions and recording each discrepancy
Inspect a chainsaw before use for chain brake, chain catcher, throttle lock and chain condition, removing a defective saw from service
Decline to fell a tree that exceeds the operator's qualification or shows unmanageable defects, choosing an alternative such as leaving, blasting or mechanical felling
Evaluate other sawyers' felling and bucking in the field against the certification standard, recording each evaluation and any retraining required
Brief a field crew on the day's site hazards, escape routes, safety zones and communication plan before work begins
Stop field work when hazards change beyond the controls in the job hazard analysis, re-briefing the crew before work resumes
Recognize early heat illness or smoke exposure symptoms in crew members, removing affected people from exposure and starting care
Plan work-rest cycles, hydration and acclimatization for crews working in heat or smoke, adjusting schedules as exposure readings rise

Prepare and revise management plans for publicly held lands
Brief decision-makers and elected officials for authoritative decisions
Design developmental work experiences that preserve the formation of professional judgment
Elicit, document and transfer tacit and institutional knowledge before people leave
Design and administer cross-jurisdictional stewardship agreements
Administer contracts, grants and intergovernmental agreements
Assess the durability and reversal risk of policy choices and time actions to policy windows
Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality
Govern enterprise environmental data and AI portfolios
Track regulatory change and translate it into operating guidance
Navigate legislative and governing-body processes for environmental programs
Evaluate and certify others' task performance against position standards
Apply systems thinking across ecological, institutional and technical systems
Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings
Develop proposals and grant applications for environmental work
Specify, evaluate and accept AI and analytics services in procurement
Design human-in-the-loop review for AI-assisted environmental workflows
Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work
Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work
Validate AI-generated work products before professional use
Record provenance and AI involvement in work products
Conduct job analyses and write job-related assessments for technical positions
Justify positions and staffing with workload and mission evidence
Set programme strategy and lead organizational and technological change in environmental programmes
Run the adaptive management cycle and evaluate programme performance
Supervise staff and volunteers in environmental work
Communicate technical environmental information in writing and speech
Apply merit-based, job-related practices in recruitment and team management
Develop and compare policy and land-use scenarios for environmental decisions

topTasks.statement: Prepare a program budget request and justification linking each funding increment to outputs and outcomes the budget office can verify
Reconcile program obligations and expenditures against appropriations, agreements and fee accounts each month, flagging any use outside purpose or period
Prepare a continuing-resolution and funding-lapse contingency plan, ranking program activities by legal requirement and consequence of delay
Brief appropriations staff or a governing board on a program budget request, answering questions with figures traceable to the justification
Design a fee or cost-recovery schedule for a permit or service program within its statutory authority, documenting the cost basis for each fee
Assess the reversal risk of a program's key instruments, recording the evidence, the likely triggers and a contingency for each high-risk instrument
Classify each instrument a program relies on by type and the process needed to change it, recording who can change it and how quickly
Write a decision memo for an accountable official, stating the decision required, options, evidence, risks and a recommendation within two pages
Brief a decision-maker orally on a pending decision under time pressure, answering questions and stating where the evidence is uncertain
Advise an official in writing when the evidence does not support a preferred option, recording the advice given in the decision file
Prepare a staff report for a governing body's public meeting, stating findings, options and the legal basis for each recommended action
Track bills, ordinances and appropriations measures affecting the program, summarizing each relevant provision's effect on program operations
